record.original_question: In the same continuous high-low guessing game with h in [0,1], high/low feedback after each guess, and payoff Σ|g_n-h| to the hider, what is an optimal strategy for the hider?

evidence.quote: Blue chooses a secret number h ∈[0,1]. Red repeatedly guesses it and is told whether the guess is too high or too low (the probability of guessing the ex- act number is zero). If g n is the sequence of guesses, then Blue’s payoff is equal to ∑ |gn −h|.
An optimal strategy for the hider has never been determined.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Two players, a Hider and a Guesser, play the following infinite-horizon game. The Hider secretly chooses a number $h \in [0,1]$ (possibly according to a randomized strategy, i.e., a probability distribution on $[0,1]$). The Guesser then makes a sequence of guesses $g_1, g_2, g_3, \ldots \in [0,1]$; after each guess $g_n$, the Guesser is told only whether $g_n > h$ ("too high") or $g_n < h$ ("too low"). (The event $g_n = h$ occurs with probability zero under any nonatomic distribution and is ignored.) The Guesser uses this high/low feedback to choose subsequent guesses, and aims to minimize the total payoff
$$P = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} |g_n - h|,$$
which is paid to the Hider; the Hider aims to maximize the expected value of $P$.

Determine an optimal (in general, randomized) strategy for the Hider in this zero-sum game, i.e., a probability distribution on $[0,1]$ that attains
$$\sup_{\mu} \inf_{\text{Guesser strategies}} \mathbb{E}_{h \sim \mu}\!\left[\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} |g_n - h|\right].$$
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is described as an unsolved open problem in a compilation of open problems on search games at zbMATH (6687175), which explicitly states "An optimal strategy for the hider has never been determined." A web search did not surface any subsequent work resolving the optimal hider strategy for this continuous high-low guessing game with cumulative-distance payoff.

status_evidence.snippet: An optimal strategy for the hider has never been determined.
status_evidence.claim: The optimal hider strategy in this continuous high-low guessing game is stated as not yet determined.
